sentences.l2: Medicine is changing fast because doctors want to find the best way to help sick people.
sentences.l1: 医学正在快速变化，因为医生想找到帮助病人的最佳方法。

sentences.l2: In the past, doctors gave the same pills to everyone who had the same sickness.
sentences.l1: 过去，医生会给所有患同一种病的人开同样的药丸。

sentences.l2: Today, a new idea called personalized medicine helps doctors look closely at a person's body.
sentences.l1: 如今，一种叫做个性化医疗的新理念帮助医生仔细观察一个人的身体。

sentences.l2: By studying genetics, doctors can see how a person's body will react to a medicine.
sentences.l1: 通过研究遗传学，医生可以看出一个人的身体会对某种药物产生怎样的反应。

sentences.l2: This special science is known as pharmacogenomics.
sentences.l1: 这门特殊的科学被称为药物基因组学。

sentences.l2: When doctors use this information, they can pick a safer drug therapy that works just right for one specific person, stopping bad side effects before they even start.
sentences.l1: 当医生使用这些信息时，他们可以为某一个具体的人选出更安全、恰好有效的药物治疗，在不良副作用开始之前就将其阻止。
